purpose: Test, by a preregistered intervention, whether the board power limit is what lowers AICLK under sustained Newton-Schulz load. Issue #121 Q2 classified all three runs as H-OTHER; its post-hoc observation that plateau board_power_w sat within 0.3 percent of BOARD_POWER_LIMIT is a correlation only and is not used to set any criterion here.

intervention.variable: active Newton-Schulz worker core count n
intervention.held_constant: per-core work: each active worker receives 9 or 10 matrix blocks per launch, the same per-core distribution as the Q2 108-core workload (1024 blocks over 108 cores)
intervention.total_blocks_rule: total_blocks(n) = round(1024 * n / 108); blocks are distributed with divmod, so every active core holds 9 or 10 blocks
intervention.reason: With the ADR-0013 batch of 8192 matrices held fixed, only 79-108 cores fit in L1 (board-free L1 ledger), and every count in that range is estimated to exceed 300 W at asic_fmax. A below-limit configuration is required to test H-BPL, so total work scales with n and per-core work is fixed.
intervention.adr_0013_departure: Configurations other than n=108 depart from the ADR-0013 batch. This is a power intervention, not a performance or image-quality measurement; no throughput figure from it is to be compared with ADR-0013 results.
intervention.n108_identity: n=108 is the exact Q2 workload (1024 blocks, batch 8192).
intervention.l1_requirement: The per-core L1 footprint must be identical for every n; the harness verifies this board-free before any run and rejects a configuration that differs.
intervention.core_selection: Active cores are a deterministic, documented subset of the 108-core worker pool (the two resident cores are excluded as in Q2); the coordinates are recorded per run.
intervention.other_parameters: Identical to Q2: ADR-0013 configuration (BF16 state, FP32 destination, HiFi3, fused S, matrix block 8, double buffering, full DEST sync, input/R/X0 in L1, output in DRAM), 12 fixed iterations, no convergence check.

estimate.status: estimate only; it chose the configurations and sets no criterion
estimate.model: board_power_w at asic_fmax, unthrottled: B0 + b * n

B0_w.source: Q2 samples about 2.25 s after workload start (AICLK 1350, power_w 81-82, current 95-96 A, 0.86 V)

n108_w.source: Q2 samples about 4.49 s after workload start (AICLK 1343, power_w 210-212, current 254-257 A, 0.83 V)

uncertainty: B0 is one sample per run during ramp-up; if cores were already partly active it overstates the zero-load intercept, which makes the below-limit estimate conservative and the slope an underestimate.

Steady state adds fan power (Q2 fan rose from about 2650 to about 4100 rpm), GDDR heating and temperature-dependent leakage; Q2 lost a further ~7 percent AICLK between 7 s and the plateau at constant ~300 W. The uplift is bounded here as at most 40 W * n / 108.
With B0 as low as 160 W the slope becomes 2.24 W/core; the C081 and C108 estimates remain above 300 W and the C054 estimate falls below it.

measurement_scope.device_note: Same physical board as Q2. Device 0 differs at idle in GDDR temperature and fan speed (Issue #121 post-hoc observation); that difference is a recorded confound, and device 0 is not used.
measurement_scope.run_duration_definition: Fixed workload interval of sustained device work; setup and teardown are outside it.
measurement_scope.run_guard_definition: Workload subprocess timeout and harness deadline. 120 s load + 40 s runner margin + 5 s headroom. A run that reaches the guard fails and is never extended.
measurement_scope.order_definition: Sequence S followed by its reverse, so each configuration's mean position is equal and slow drift across the session cancels in the configuration comparison.

smoke_runs.purpose: Confirm that each new core set launches and records; the L1 ledger does not prove a launch. Smoke runs are diagnostics, not verdict evidence, and are under the 60 s approval threshold.

measurement_scope.approval: Each run longer than 60 s requires owner approval per instance. A run after a reset requires renewed approval.

plateau.interval_definition: [run_start_monotonic_ns + 60 s, run_start_monotonic_ns + 120 s); left-held samples, positive-duration segments only, terminal coverage required, no extrapolation.
plateau.justification: In Q2 AICLK was 962-968 MHz at 60 s and 956-962 MHz at 150 s; the residual drift is expected and preregistered, not a reason to move the window.

statistics.aggregate: For aiclk_mhz, board_power_w, power_w, current_a, voltage_v, asic_temp_c, fan_rpm and each GDDR channel temperature: duration-weighted mean, min, max over the plateau, as defined in the Q2 plan.
statistics.per_configuration: Each run is evaluated individually; a configuration criterion passes only when it passes in both runs of that configuration.

limits.source: Read from the pre-run snapshot of each run (limits.* keys, as in Q2). A run whose snapshot reports a different value uses its own value, and the difference is reported. A missing limit makes the dependent criterion not_evaluable, never substituted.

criteria.tolerance_rule: One tolerance for every limit: a signal is pinned at a limit when its plateau duration-weighted mean is within 2 percent of the documented limit value. The tolerance is set from the limit, not from any Q2 observation.
criteria.aiclk_depressed: plateau duration-weighted mean AICLK < 0.95 * asic_fmax (1282.5 MHz)

common_preconditions.P1-below-limit-unthrottled: C018 is aiclk_not_depressed in both runs.
common_preconditions.P2-above-limit-throttled: C081 and C108 are aiclk_depressed in both runs.
common_preconditions.P3-monotonic: In each half of the order (S and its reverse), plateau mean AICLK of C081 > that of C108. A fixed frequency cap would not show this.

hypothesis_support.rule: Hypothesis X is supported when P1, P2 and P3 hold, X's signal is pinned in every run of C081 and C108, and X's signal is not pinned in either run of C018.

criteria.minimum_evidence: A limiter verdict requires at least two throttled verdict-bearing configurations (C081 and C108). C054 never enters the verdict.
criteria.correlation_warning: A supported label means the preregistered pattern was observed; it does not establish a physical mechanism inside the firmware.

classification_policy.not_evaluable: If a required signal or limit is missing in any verdict-bearing run, the verdict is not_evaluable and names the missing field.

expected_pattern: C018 stays at or near 1350 MHz with board_power_w below 294 W.
C081 and C108 both pin board_power_w in [294, 306] W, with C081 at a higher AICLK than C108.
current_a and power_w stay below their pinned bands in C081 and C108 (Q2: about 177 A and 130 W).
asic_temp_c stays below 88.2 degC in every configuration.
prediction.basis: Issue #121 Q2 post-hoc observations; they inform the prediction only.

prediction_mismatch_policy: If C018 is depressed, report H-OTHER under P1 and examine whether a frequency limit other than power, current or temperature applies at low load; do not lower n and rerun without a new plan revision and approval.
If P3 fails while board power is pinned, report H-OTHER and examine whether the firmware applies a fixed frequency step rather than a continuous power limit.
If H-TDC or H-TDP is supported, audit the limit provenance in the pre-run snapshots before any interpretation.

exploratory.status: reported separately; never enters the verdict
items: Onset ordering in the first 10 s of each run (about 2 s sampling).
Plateau drift of AICLK against fan_rpm, GDDR temperatures and asic_temp_c at pinned board power.
The rise of AICLK in the last seconds of a load interval, as seen near 280 s in Q2.

cooldown.required_between: every consecutive pair of long runs
cooldown.baseline_source: the preceding run's pre-run snapshot on the selected device; fail closed if unavailable
cooldown.criterion: power_w <= baseline + 5 W and asic_temp_c <= baseline + 3 degC
cooldown.aiclk_not_used: AICLK is not a cooldown criterion: idle AICLK is 800 MHz, and 1350 MHz is a loaded value.
cooldown.cap_policy: Reaching the cap stops the session; the remaining runs need renewed approval.

trace.unit_rule: Each added column is decoded only after its unit and packing are established from the pinned tt-smi / tt-umd source with the same provenance standard as the Q2 unit_provenance; MAX_GDDR_TEMP is not decoded.

provenance.persisted_output_paths: Basenames or container-relative names only; no hostname, username or user-specific absolute path.
provenance.calibration: Per configuration; the Q2 108-core calibration constant is not reused.

limitations: No board measurement is included in this plan.
About 2 s telemetry sampling limits onset claims to about 2 s.
Only one board is measured; board-to-board differences are not addressed.
Changing n changes total work and heat together; the verdict rests on the cross-configuration pattern against documented limits, not on any single run.

revision_history.change: Created the preregistered plan: active-core intervention with fixed per-core work, configurations C018/C054/C081/C108, 8 runs of 120 s in S + reverse(S) order on device 1, 2 percent limit tolerance, preconditions P1-P3, smoke runs under 60 s, GDDR channel columns.
